First business: bow my head and apologize. Deeply.

Kageaki"Your Highness, Prince Maidono. ...The other day, very great trouble I caused you. I offer my humblest apologies."
Chief"..."
Kageaki"After all your kindness, instead of repaying it I have repaid you with harm... With what face can I stand before you?"
Prince Maidono"Bas, bas, Kageaki... Such a grown man, folding himself so small. That will not do."

The voice from behind the blinds held no reproach. If anything, he was trying to soothe me.

But after what I had done, I could hardly think, ah, good, that was settled. Raising my head was not coming easily.

Chief"...Sir!"

en.html:
The Prince, administrator of Hachiman Shrine, clapped his hands twice as he spoke.
The Chief and I bowed at exactly the same time. Neither had arranged it.

Wah. With my own tsurugi, two years to learn cooperation. With another man who felt he had caused trouble, perfect coordination at once. Perhaps we had been practicing the wrong thing. Order us to attack and there might be confusion; tell us to stop apologizing and down went both heads together. One final apology, Your Highness. For continuing the apologies.

Kageaki"Sir."
Prince Maidono"That guard back at the detention center, say a word of thanks to him, haan? He did not create unnecessary uproar. Because of him we could keep this a small matter."
Kageaki"...I see."

Chief"No. That is urgent also, but... today we need to discuss something else."
Kageaki"Sir...?"
Prince Maidono"Kageaki, understood, na? What we say now must not go outside this room..."
Prince Maidono"Though with you, why am I even insisting."
Chief"Still, Your Highness, given the nature of the matter... Kageaki."
Kageaki"Sir. Whatever the matter may be, from me it will go no further. I promise."
Prince Maidono"Haan, haan. A man like you says that, Kageaki, and one can genuinely breathe easily."

en.html:
Hohoho, the Prince laughed. But tension was there inside the laughter too.

Something considerable, it seemed.
...Political, probably. Of course.

But for such a discussion, why take the trouble to call me?
